completeness.evidence: Lists 38 m², Clausen, furnished, renovated, but omits price 1750 and bathroom/bedroom counts.

tone_discipline.evidence: No exclamation marks or hyperbolic adjectives; 'ruhige und einladende Atmosphäre' is measured.

fair_housing.evidence: No demographic references in the German text.

hallucination.evidence: 'Eichenparkettboden' (oak parquet) is not in inputs which only specify 'wood floor'.
